mainEntity.name: Why 3,500 calories per pound of fat?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's a long-standing approximation for the energy stored in a pound of body fat. It works for short-term planning, but because maintenance calories fall as you lose weight, it overestimates how much you'll lose over months.

mainEntity.name: Should I recalculate as I lose weight?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — as your weight decreases, your maintenance calories typically decrease too, so recalculating every few weeks keeps your target accurate rather than relying on a calculation made at your starting weight.

mainEntity.name: What is the lowest safe calorie target?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adult guidelines commonly use about 1,200 kcal a day for women and 1,500 kcal a day for men as the lower end for a weight-loss diet without medical supervision. Very-low-calorie diets should only be followed under a healthcare provider's care.
